ops.title: Close the pollAccount SyncOverlay vs ccp remove orphan-dir race
ops.description: Sim-observed (sync final validation, 2026-07-08): daemon pollAccount calls m.SyncOverlay (internal/daemon/scheduler.go:282) which MkdirAll+relinks the account dir; a concurrent ccp remove in the CLI's own Manager can be raced by an in-flight poll that read the account list before DeleteAccount, re-creating the torn-down dir as an orphan (row gone, dir present; no secret, no data loss). Pre-existing, not sync-specific. Options: (a) route ccp remove through the daemon like migrate/credmove; (b) take the per-account flock in SyncOverlay and skip if the row vanished; (c) re-check GetAccount(id) immediately before the MkdirAll (smallest); (d) accept + doctor orphan-dir sweep.

ops.text: a concurrent remove during a poll tick leaves no orphan account dir (or doctor sweeps it)
